<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 134.10955 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral exact mass of ≈133.1023 Da. The isotopic pattern shows an M+1 peak at ~11 % of the base, consistent with about ten carbon atoms (each 13C contributes ~1.1 %). A formula of C₁₀H₁₃ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 133.1017 Da, matching the observed mass within <1 mDa, and fits the isotopic pattern. No oxygen or other heteroatoms are required. Therefore the molecular formula is C10H13.</thought>
<final_answer>C10H13</final_answer>
